original_criterion.criterion_summary: One demographic read must select a supported snapshot/layout as a whole rather than independently choosing targets, priors, and optional donor by filename. Preserve supported old layouts and bytes. Full capability requires one source-qualified, versioned source-to-state inventory with ordered IDs/mappings, target and entrant meanings, prior axes/derivation/time, donor-present versus intentional-absence declaration, producer/profile/schema/rule/epoch, and content-bound member references.
original_criterion.occurrence_policy: Preserve this one canonical occurrence individually; do not infer closure from adjacent C05, S1, or reader-level work.

bounded_reader_claim.claim: The committed reader implementation classifies all six known new/legacy target, prior, and donor path entries before layout selection. A genuinely absent entry differs from a readable regular file (including a resolving file symlink) and from a present-invalid entry; dangling links, directories/non-files, and inaccessible/malformed parent entries refuse. All three scalar readers and the aggregate reader share the selector. An explicit layout requires that layout’s targets and priors. Optional donor returns an empty mapping only for true absence in an unselected root with no known members, or for a selected complete snapshot that omits donor. No-selector isolated legacy single-member compatibility remains.
negative_and_positive_bounds: New and legacy complete layouts are readable; ambiguous complete layouts require explicit selection.
Mixed layouts, missing required members under explicit selection, malformed JSON, present-invalid entries, and cross-layout member mixtures refuse rather than falling back.
Readable file symlinks remain supported; dangling symlinks do not become optional absence.
The reader validates local file/layout coherence only; it does not prove that members came from one source-authorized inventory.
